rationale: Both candidates miss the four most severe GT bugs (model_metadata.py alias gap, ref2va task-default regression, cache-dit refresh-only-transformer bug, missing combined-mode perf qualification) and all SamitHuang style nits, so recall is low for both. X casts a wider net (12+ tiered findings) and independently corroborates two of Y's own findings (omni_snapshot_download filename-gating, load_weights contiguity coupling) plus catches diff-grounded doc regressions (dangling MODEL_ROOT reference, dropped HF_HUB_OFFLINE), giving it a slight recall/actionability edge via its severity-tiered structure. Y is more tightly evidence-cited per claim and lands a sharper, deeper hit on the GT's TTS validation gap (E), but its 'validated' pass on the cache-dit refresh path is a false reassurance on the single most severe GT concern (A), which slightly undercuts its overall reliability.
